title: agility R1: single developer spawn for tdd tier with two-commit discipline
description: Agility review 2026-07-01 (see state/sessions/20260524T000000Z-65fa92c6/artifacts/agility-review-2026-07-01.md), recommendation R1. Today tdd tickets spawn the developer TWICE (TEST mode then IMPL mode); each spawn pays full cold-context acquisition, roughly doubling developer cost per ticket. Replace with a SINGLE spawn that: (a) writes the failing tests encoding every AC, (b) runs them and CAPTURES the red output as evidence they fail for the right reason, (c) commits them as a test: commit, (d) implements, (e) runs the per-ticket gate, (f) commits the implementation. Tests-first stays provable: the test: commit strictly precedes the impl commit in git log, the captured red run is included in the hand-off, and the fresh-context reviewer may re-run the tests against the impl-commit parent when suspicious. The reviewer remains the independent quality sensor - historical RC HIGHs were caught by fresh-context review, not by the TEST/IMPL context separation. Estimated saving: 40-50 percent of developer cost/time per tdd ticket.
acceptance_criteria: agents/developer.md and its .claude/agents parity copy: the tdd workflow is a single spawn with the two-commit discipline (write failing tests, capture red run, test: commit, implement, gate, impl commit); the dual TEST/IMPL spawn protocol for tdd is removed.

orchestrator-routing SKILL.md (both copies byte-identical): the Two-phase developer spawn section is replaced by the single-spawn two-commit protocol, including what the reviewer verifies (test: commit precedes impl commit; red-run evidence present in hand-off; reviewer may re-run tests against the impl-commit parent).
agents/reviewer.md and parity copy: for tdd tickets the reviewer checks commit order and red-run evidence as part of verification.
CLAUDE.md workflow (step 4, tdd bullet) updated consistently with the new protocol.
All existing specs green (any spec asserting the old two-spawn prose is updated with the feature); skill parity gate green.
